title: Path Traversal in Go
description: A Go handler reads files using a user-supplied path with no traversal protection.

finding.title: Path Traversal
finding.description: A file name from the query string is joined to a directory without checking for '..' segments.
finding.why_dangerous: The path walker lets input escape 'files/' and read files elsewhere on the filesystem.
finding.impact: Read arbitrary host files (config, secrets, source), information disclosure.
finding.fix: Canonicalize the resolved path and ensure it stays under an allowed root with an allowlist.
learning_example: Input: ../../etc/shadow walks out of the downloads directory
After filepath.Join + prefix check the request is refused

checklist: Sanitize and validate file paths from input
Resolve and verify paths stay inside a trusted root
Prefer allowlists of valid keys over free-form file names
Restrict the filesystem access for the service user
Apply OS-level permission on the served directory
